messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: ref(), sum(), and variable tracking
parts:
> Fixed now, apparently.

I have no idea what's going on with
your linux system. We're not seeing any
of these problems on clang++ or g++
on either Mac or Windows.

We're going to move to system-specific builds,
I think.

> Except the variable tracking size limit
> thing ...

Variable tracking is part of optimization.
Maybe this is partly why g++ takes FOREVER to
compile compared to clang++.

> EXCEPTION. parse error at file STDIN line 62 column 22
> d_b_0<- 0.0001 + sum(tau_b_0_like) / 2.0;
> ^-- here

Thanks. I just added a function signature
type-checking to the parser, and forgot to declare an
overloaded version of sum() for arrays. You can
find these in src/stan/gm/function_signatures.hpp.

- Bob
